documents.content:
# Offer Brief

## Portfolio scope: graph8, CIENCE, and Tenbound

The graph8 organization has three distinct offers: graph8 software and buyer-data infrastructure, CIENCE managed GTM execution, and the Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint assessment. Each delivers standalone value; all three compose on the same system.

---

## graph8 Platform Offer

**What it is:** A revenue orchestration platform that connects buyer data, outbound sequences, inbox, CRM, and analytics in one workspace.

**Price:** $99/month (Team plan). Enterprise pricing available.

**Who it is for:** B2B revenue teams that need to connect disconnected GTM tools and run coordinated outbound without adding headcount.

**Core deliverables:**
- Unified buyer data and contact database
- Sequence builder with email, LinkedIn, phone, SMS, and voice AI channels
- AI-assisted campaign studio and content generation
- CRM sync, deal pipeline, and inbox management
- Operator agents: RevOps, Lead Ops, Deal Desk, Deliverability

**Standalone value:** A team can run the full outbound motion on graph8 alone, without CIENCE or Tenbound.

---

## CIENCE Managed GTM Execution Offer

**What it is:** A fully managed outbound execution service. CIENCE supplies trained SDR and operations teams that run inside the client's graph8 workspace.

**Price:** $5,000 setup fee + $2,000/month per team + performance fees. Entry managed tier at $2,499/month is available for SMB.

**Who it is for:** Companies that need outbound capacity and execution expertise but do not want to hire and manage an in-house SDR team.

**Core deliverables:**
- Dedicated SDR team running sequences on behalf of the client
- Campaign strategy, copy, and targeting managed by CIENCE operators
- Weekly reporting and pipeline attribution inside graph8
- SLA-backed meeting and pipeline targets

**Standalone value:** CIENCE can operate on any tech stack, but delivers faster results when running inside graph8.

---

## Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint Offer

**What it is:** A paid $1,000 three-week Fractional Director of Enablement (FDE) assessment that diagnoses the client's pipeline architecture, outbound program, and revenue system gaps. Delivers a written Blueprint and prioritized remediation roadmap.

**Price:** $1,000 (paid assessment). This is not a free offer. The Blueprint is a paid engagement.

**Who it is for:** Revenue leaders, founders, and GTM operators who need an outside diagnostic before investing in tooling or headcount. Ideal for teams with a pipeline problem they cannot diagnose internally.

**Core deliverables:**
- Three-week FDE engagement (remote)
- Full audit of outbound program, ICP, sequences, pipeline hygiene, and tooling
- Written Programmable Revenue Blueprint report
- Prioritized roadmap: what to fix, in what order, and with what resources
- Optional: handoff to graph8 platform onboarding or CIENCE managed execution

**Booking:** 30-minute calendar reservation (asks for a 15-minute diagnostic conversation). Host: Thomas Cornelius.
Booking URL: https://app.graph8.com/appointments/team/graph8-new/programmable-revenue-blueprint/1103

**Standalone value:** The Blueprint is actionable without purchasing graph8 or CIENCE. Most clients implement at least one recommendation within 30 days of delivery.

**Complimentary add-on for meeting attendees:** Four months of graph8 MCP Unlimited included at no charge for anyone who attends the initial meeting with Thomas.

---

## Competitive Advantage

The portfolio's primary competitive advantage is composition: a buyer can start with the paid $1,000 Tenbound Blueprint to diagnose gaps, adopt the graph8 platform ($99/mo) to execute, and engage CIENCE ($2,499+/mo) to run it -- each delivers standalone value and all three work together on the same system.

Competitors offer one layer (data, agency, or software) but not a composed diagnostic-to-execution path. Tenbound provides the diagnosis, graph8 provides the infrastructure, and CIENCE provides the operator capacity -- all under one coordinated system.

---

## Pricing Summary

| Offer | Price | Type |
|---|---|---|
| graph8 Team | $99/month | Software subscription |
| CIENCE SMB Managed | $2,499/month | Managed service |
| CIENCE Enterprise Managed | $5,000 setup + $2,000/month/team | Managed service |
| Tenbound Blueprint | $1,000 | Paid assessment (one-time) |
| graph8 MCP Unlimited (meeting attendee add-on) | $0 for 4 months | Complimentary for anyone who attends the initial meeting with Thomas |

---

## Entry Points

Three paths into the portfolio:

1. **Start with the platform** -- sign up for graph8 at $99/month and run your own outbound motion.
2. **Start with managed execution** -- engage CIENCE to run outbound on your behalf, with or without graph8.
3. **Start with the diagnosis** -- purchase the paid $1,000 Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint to understand what to fix before investing in tooling or headcount. The Blueprint roadmap maps directly to graph8 and CIENCE capabilities.

All three entry points compose: a client who starts at any point can add the others without switching systems.

# Pricing Matrix

## Portfolio scope: graph8, CIENCE, and Tenbound

Pricing covers three distinct offers: graph8 Team at $99/month; CIENCE managed service with $5,000 setup plus $2,000/month team plus $499/month platform; and Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint at $1,000 for three weeks. These are published entry-price anchors, not an exhaustive rate card. Tenbound's assessment fee is separate from software subscription and managed-service charges. Keep one-time and recurring fees separate and verify the applicable agreement for options and terms.

---

# Pricing Matrix

**Pricing Model:** Three-brand portfolio with distinct pricing models per brand. **graph8 platform:** Usage-based execution pricing with a free tier, a per-user data plan ($25/user), and a flat-rate unlimited team plan ($99/mo). Credits are spent when the system executes (sends, calls, agent runs); data search and browse is always free. Credit rate ladder: $0.05/credit (Pay As You Go) → $0.01/credit (MCP Unlimited) → included (Team plan). **CIENCE managed services:** One-time GTM setup sprint ($5,000) plus month-to-month recurring fees for strategic team ($2,000/mo) and graph8 platform license ($499/mo); optional SDR capacity quoted separately by level and geography. **Tenbound:** Fixed-price assessment product — Programmable Revenue Blueprint at $1,000 one-time; Revenue System Setup builds at $9,500 (Standard) or $25,000 (Deployed).

**Currency:** USD

## Tiers

### graph8 Free / Pay As You Go

**Tier Name:** graph8 Free / Pay As You Go
**Description:** A free entry point to the full graph8 platform. No credit card required. 1,000 contact reveals and 500 execution actions included to start, then pay per credit at $0.05/credit.
**Target Customer:** Individuals and small teams trying out the platform before committing to a paid plan.
**Price:** Free to start; then $0.05 per credit
**Billing Frequency:** Pay as you go (no subscription)
**Features Included:**
- 1,000 contact reveals to start
- 500 execution actions free
- Full platform access
- Free search and browse of 700M+ contacts and 100M+ companies
- Free buyer intent and anonymous visitor identification
- App, MCP, and CLI access

**Features Limited:**
- Credits charged at $0.05 each after free allocation
- Contact data reveals, lookups, enrichments, and exports draw from credit pool
- No monthly cap lifted — pay per credit consumed

**Features Excluded:**
- Unlimited users (seat-limited on this tier)
- 10,000 monthly execution credits org-wide (Team plan only)
- MCP Unlimited for every user (Team plan only)

**Limits:**
- 1,000 contact reveals included at start
- 500 execution actions included at start
- Fair-use rate limits apply

**Recommended:** False

### graph8 MCP Unlimited

**Tier Name:** graph8 MCP Unlimited
**Description:** Unlimited contact data in your AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) via the MCP server. Priced per user, not per org. 2,500 execution credits per month included.
**Target Customer:** Individual power users who primarily work with B2B contact data through AI tools and need unlimited data access without the full team platform.
**Price:** $25/user/month
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly
**Features Included:**
- Unlimited contact data under fair use
- 2,500 execution credits per month
- MCP server access (query buyer graph from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT)
- Free search and browse of 700M+ contacts and 100M+ companies
- App, MCP, and CLI access
- Credit rate: $0.01/credit for execution beyond included allotment

**Features Limited:**
- 2,500 execution credits per month (vs. 10,000 on Team plan)
- Priced per user — not unlimited users org-wide
- Unlimited contact data subject to fair-use limits

**Features Excluded:**
- Unlimited users, no seat fees (Team plan only)
- 10,000 execution credits org-wide (Team plan only)
- Full platform apps: campaigns, dialer, AI voice, AI inbox, meetings, CRM, Studio, workflows (Team plan only)

**Limits:**
- 2,500 execution credits/month per user
- Fair-use rate limits apply
- Per-user pricing — cost scales with headcount

**Recommended:** False

### graph8 Team Plan

**Tier Name:** graph8 Team Plan
**Description:** The full graph8 platform for the whole org — unlimited users, unlimited data, every app, one bill. Includes 10,000 execution credits per month org-wide. 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
**Target Customer:** B2B revenue teams (SDRs, AEs, RevOps, marketing) that want to replace their fragmented GTM stack with one autonomous revenue system. No seat fees — the whole org on one plan.
**Price:** $99/month
**Billing Frequency:** Month-to-month (no annual contract required)
**Features Included:**
- 10,000 execution credits per month (org-wide)
- Unlimited users — no seat fees
- MCP Unlimited for every user (a $25/user value, included org-wide)
- No monthly cap on contact data reveals, lookups, enrichments, and exports
- Campaigns and sending infrastructure (mailboxes, domains, deliverability)
- 5-channel sequencer (email, phone, LinkedIn, SMS, WhatsApp)
- Dialer and AI voice agents (clone any rep voice for inbound and outbound calls)
- AI inbox (replies triaged, drafted, and answered across every channel)
- Meeting routing and booking
- CRM, pipeline, and quotes (AE Cockpit, deals, forecasting, quote-to-cash, e-sign, billing automation)
- Studio content engine (brand, newsletters, landing pages, ads, campaign content, 44 GTM intelligence docs)
- AI agents and workflows (Chief of Staff, SDR Agent, RevOps Agent — Operator and Executor)
- Buying signals (visitors, intent, hiring, job-change signals on every account)
- Waterfall enrichment (third-party providers, pay on match or bring your own keys)
- Free search and browse of 700M+ contacts and 100M+ companies
- Built-in CDP and integrations (500+ connectors, two-way CRM sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Outreach, Salesloft)
- Data warehouse integration
- Open API, MCP server, and CLI access
- Team collaboration workspace (Work — channels, DMs, threads, agents in the room)
- Team HQ and leaderboard
- Analytics and reporting
- 7-day free trial, no credit card

**Features Limited:**
- Fair-use rate limits apply (guard against scraping, not real GTM work)
- Execution credits included: 10,000/month org-wide; additional credits available

**Limits:**
- 10,000 execution credits included per month org-wide
- Fair-use rate limits on data and execution
- Month-to-month; no annual discount publicly disclosed

**Recommended:** True

### CIENCE GTM Setup Sprint

**Tier Name:** CIENCE GTM Setup Sprint
**Description:** One-time 5-day sprint to build the complete GTM system: 4 campaigns (intent-based, ICP-driven, visitor targeting, competitor targeting), target data configuration, outbound and inbound digital infrastructure, and AI SDR setup. Delivered by a Campaign Operation Strike Team (GTM Engineer, AI/LLM Technician, Data Analyst).
**Target Customer:** B2B teams that need a fully configured, production-ready GTM system stood up in days rather than months, without internal engineering resources.
**Price:** $5,000 one-time
**Billing Frequency:** One-time payment
**Features Included:**
- Complete GTM system and campaign setup
- 4 campaigns: intent-based, ICP-driven, visitor targeting, and competitor targeting
- Target data configuration
- Outbound and inbound digital infrastructure
- AI sales development setup
- Campaign Operation Strike Team: GTM Engineer, AI/LLM Technician, Data Analyst
- Full GTM engine live in 14 days (per CIENCE homepage)

**Features Excluded:**
- Ongoing strategic execution (Performance-Driven Growth, priced separately at $2,000/mo)
- graph8 platform license (priced separately at $499/mo)
- SDR capacity (quoted separately)

**Limits:**
- One-time engagement; does not include ongoing execution

**Recommended:** False

### CIENCE Performance-Driven Growth (Strategic Team)

**Tier Name:** CIENCE Performance-Driven Growth (Strategic Team)
**Description:** Month-to-month managed GTM execution with a dedicated strategic team providing full-scale campaign management, continuous optimization, and strategic oversight to keep the pipeline motion active.
**Target Customer:** B2B teams that have completed the GTM Setup Sprint and need an ongoing expert team to manage, optimize, and scale outbound and inbound campaigns.
**Price:** $2,000/month
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly (month-to-month)
**Features Included:**
- Full-scale campaign management and continuous optimization
- Strategic oversight to keep the pipeline motion active
- Dedicated GTM team
- CIENCE GTM team can generate held meetings as part of the program

**Features Limited:**
- CIENCE GTM Team Meetings are charged at the same active held-meeting fee as SDR meetings; do not count toward SDR performance targets

**Features Excluded:**
- graph8 platform license (priced separately at $499/mo)
- SDR capacity (quoted separately by level and geography)

**Limits:**
- Per-meeting fee calculated from agreed ROI goal (typically 4x ROI) using the campaign calculator — exact fee is not publicly listed

**Recommended:** False

### CIENCE graph8 Platform License (via CIENCE)

**Tier Name:** CIENCE graph8 Platform License (via CIENCE)
**Description:** The graph8 platform license as bundled within the CIENCE managed service offering. Includes 75,000 monthly credits, AI-driven outreach, visitor deanonymization, data enrichment, and management of emails, calls, and automated workflows in one system.
**Target Customer:** CIENCE managed service clients who need the graph8 platform as the infrastructure layer under their managed GTM motion.
**Price:** $499/month
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly (recurring)
**Features Included:**
- 75,000 monthly credits included
- AI-driven outreach
- Visitor deanonymization
- Data enrichment
- Email, call, and automated workflow management in one system
- Scaled credit tiers available at discounts as volume grows

**Features Limited:**
- Scaled credit tiers at discounts available — specific volume tiers and discount amounts not publicly listed

**Limits:**
- 75,000 monthly credits included; additional volume available at scaled pricing (details not publicly listed)

**Recommended:** False

### CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 1 (Scripted Outreach)

**Tier Name:** CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 1 (Scripted Outreach)
**Description:** Sourced, trained, and managed SDRs at the Scripted Outreach performance level. CIENCE sources SDRs through vetted agencies or direct hires, trains them into the client's motion, and supervises via CIENCE systems and Growth Manager.
**Target Customer:** B2B teams that need additional outreach coverage with SDRs following scripted outbound playbooks; entry-level SDR capacity.
**Price:** Offshore: $1,500/mo | Europe: $2,500/mo | US: $4,500/mo
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly
**Features Included:**
- Scripted outreach SDR profile
- CIENCE training and onboarding into your motion
- Managed contracts and payouts in-platform
- Growth Manager supervision
- SDR onboarding and recruitment: $1,000 one-time per SDR
- Commission structure: No commission below 60% of target; 60–99% of target: base salary × % of target × 0.35; 100%+ of target: base salary × % of target × 0.7

**Limits:**
- $1,000 one-time onboarding/recruitment fee per SDR (separate from monthly rate)
- Per-meeting fee calculated from agreed ROI goal — exact amount not publicly listed

**Recommended:** False

### CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 2 (Independent Producer)

**Tier Name:** CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 2 (Independent Producer)
**Description:** Sourced, trained, and managed SDRs at the Independent Producer performance level. Higher autonomy and output capability than Level 1.
**Target Customer:** B2B teams that need SDRs capable of working more independently, managing their own pipeline of outreach activities without full scripting.
**Price:** Offshore: $2,500/mo | Europe: $3,500/mo | US: $5,500/mo
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly
**Features Included:**
- Independent Producer SDR profile
- CIENCE training and onboarding into your motion
- Managed contracts and payouts in-platform
- Growth Manager supervision
- SDR onboarding and recruitment: $1,000 one-time per SDR
- Same commission structure as Level 1

**Limits:**
- $1,000 one-time onboarding/recruitment fee per SDR
- Per-meeting fee calculated from agreed ROI goal — exact amount not publicly listed

**Recommended:** False

### CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 3 (Data-Driven Optimizer)

**Tier Name:** CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 3 (Data-Driven Optimizer)
**Description:** Sourced, trained, and managed SDRs at the Data-Driven Optimizer performance level — the highest capability tier. SDRs use data and analytics to continuously improve outreach performance.
**Target Customer:** B2B teams that need senior-level SDRs who can own their own data analysis, iterate on messaging and sequences, and drive continuous improvement in outbound performance.
**Price:** Offshore: $3,500/mo | Europe: $4,500/mo | US: $6,500/mo
**Billing Frequency:** Monthly
**Features Included:**
- Data-Driven Optimizer SDR profile
- CIENCE training and onboarding into your motion
- Managed contracts and payouts in-platform
- Growth Manager supervision
- SDR onboarding and recruitment: $1,000 one-time per SDR
- Same commission structure as Levels 1 and 2

**Limits:**
- $1,000 one-time onboarding/recruitment fee per SDR
- Per-meeting fee calculated from agreed ROI goal — exact amount not publicly listed

**Recommended:** False

### Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint

**Tier Name:** Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint
**Description:** 3-week assessment where a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) shadows every role in the sales org (up to 7 roles, 45 min each), documents the revenue ontology, maps every integration gap, scores the team against the six-pillar Pipeline Architecture Standard, and delivers five implementable documents. No vendor on the other side of the plan — yours to implement with any vendor.
**Target Customer:** Revenue leaders (VPs of Sales, RevOps leaders, founders) who own a pipeline number and need an engineering-led diagnosis of exactly where their revenue system leaks and what to fix first — before committing to AI or additional tooling.
**Price:** $1,000 one-time
**Billing Frequency:** One-time payment (card via Stripe or invoice)
**Features Included:**
- 3-week engagement with one Forward Deployed Engineer
- Up to 7 roles shadowed (45 minutes each): SDR/BDR, AE, sales manager, growth manager, marketing, and others who touch pipeline
- No system access required — screen share only
- Deliverable 1: Revenue ontology (nouns, states, and links your revenue runs on)
- Deliverable 2: Every integration point and gap across the whole revenue system, with improvement for each
- Deliverable 3: Written readout — maturity level placement, six-pillar profile (Market, Signal, Message, Motion, Mastery, Measurement), findings with yearly cost on each
- Deliverable 4: Integration and setup document written for your team to implement
- Deliverable 5: Proposal for what to do next (in-house first; often three things to do yourselves)
- All five documents are yours — nothing to buy from Tenbound afterwards
- Buying holds your place in the queue (engineers run 25 sessions/month across all clients)
- Sessions recorded and transcribed for analysis

**Features Limited:**
- Start date typically a few weeks out (queue-based scheduling)
- Up to 7 roles maximum

**Features Excluded:**
- System implementation (separate — Standard Build at $9,500 or Deployed Build at $25,000)
- Ongoing managed services (CIENCE)

**Limits:**
- Up to 7 roles per engagement
- Non-refundable (all five documents delivered regardless; refund only if Tenbound cannot deliver as described)

**Recommended:** False

### Revenue System Setup — Standard Build

**Tier Name:** Revenue System Setup — Standard Build
**Description:** 60-day engagement where a Forward Deployed Engineer builds the revenue ontology fitted from an industry model, wires it into the tools already in use, adds guardrails, and installs two live plays. For common stacks.
**Target Customer:** B2B teams with common tech stacks (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) that need their revenue ontology built and integrated into a working system on graph8, so AI agents can run the motion autonomously.
**Price:** $9,500 (one-time, 60-day engagement)
**Billing Frequency:** One-time payment
**Features Included:**
- Revenue ontology fitted from an industry model
- Wired into existing tools
- Guardrails configured
- Two live plays installed
- Forward Deployed Engineer embedded for 60 days
- Common stack focus

**Features Excluded:**
- Bespoke ontology (Deployed Build only)
- Custom integrations (Deployed Build only)
- Department-wide rather than single-motion scope (Deployed Build only)

**Limits:**
- 60-day engagement
- Common stacks only — complex systems or bespoke data models require Deployed Build

**Recommended:** False

### Revenue System Setup — Deployed Build

**Tier Name:** Revenue System Setup — Deployed Build
**Description:** 60-day engagement with a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded with the client team. Bespoke ontology, custom integrations, department-wide scope rather than a single motion. For complex systems.
**Target Customer:** Enterprise or complex B2B organizations with bespoke data models, custom integrations, or multi-department revenue motions that cannot be served by a standard industry model.
**Price:** $25,000 (one-time, 60-day engagement)
**Billing Frequency:** One-time payment
**Features Included:**
- Bespoke revenue ontology (custom, not fitted from an industry model)
- Custom integrations built
- Department-wide scope (not limited to a single motion)
- Forward Deployed Engineer embedded with the team for 60 days

**Limits:**
- 60-day engagement
- Decision between Standard and Deployed is determined by system complexity, not monthly spend

**Recommended:** False

## Add Ons

### SDR Onboarding & Recruitment Fee

**Name:** SDR Onboarding & Recruitment Fee
**Description:** One-time per-SDR fee covering sourcing, recruitment, and onboarding of each SDR into the CIENCE motion. Applies to all SDR capacity levels.
**Price:** $1,000 one-time per SDR
**Applicable Tiers:**
- CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 1 (Scripted Outreach)
- CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 2 (Independent Producer)
- CIENCE SDR Capacity — Level 3 (Data-Driven Optimizer)


### Programmable Revenue Blueprint (via CIENCE)

**Name:** Programmable Revenue Blueprint (via CIENCE)
**Description:** The Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint offered as a CIENCE add-on. A 3-week FDE assessment delivering five implementable documents — revenue ontology, integration gaps, maturity readout, setup document, and proposal. Also purchasable directly at tenbound.com.
**Price:** $1,000 one-time
**Applicable Tiers:**
- CIENCE GTM Setup Sprint
- CIENCE Performance-Driven Growth (Strategic Team)


### Revenue System Setup — Standard Build

**Name:** Revenue System Setup — Standard Build
**Description:** 60-day FDE engagement to fit an industry-model ontology, wire it into existing tools, add guardrails, and install two live plays. For common stacks. Listed as a CIENCE add-on on cience.com/pricing.
**Price:** $9,500 one-time
**Applicable Tiers:**
- CIENCE GTM Setup Sprint
- CIENCE Performance-Driven Growth (Strategic Team)


### Revenue System Setup — Deployed Build

**Name:** Revenue System Setup — Deployed Build
**Description:** 60-day embedded FDE engagement for bespoke ontology, custom integrations, and department-wide scope. For complex systems requiring more than a standard industry model.
**Price:** $25,000 one-time
**Applicable Tiers:**
- CIENCE GTM Setup Sprint
- CIENCE Performance-Driven Growth (Strategic Team)


### Scaled Credit Tiers (CIENCE graph8 Platform)

**Name:** Scaled Credit Tiers (CIENCE graph8 Platform)
**Description:** Volume-based credit upgrades above the 75,000 monthly credits included in the CIENCE $499/mo platform license. Discounts increase as credit volume grows. Specific tier breakpoints and discount percentages not publicly listed.
**Price:** Custom / Contact CIENCE
**Applicable Tiers:**
- CIENCE graph8 Platform License (via CIENCE)


## Discounts

### Item 1

**Discount Type:** Volume (Credit Scaling)
**Amount:** Not publicly specified — 'discounts as volume grows'
**Conditions:** Applies to CIENCE clients on the $499/mo graph8 platform license who need more than 75,000 monthly credits. CIENCE states scaled credit tiers are available at discounts as volume grows; specific breakpoints and percentages are not published.
**Approval Required:** False

### Item 2

**Discount Type:** SDR Commission — Below Target
**Amount:** No commission paid below 60% of target
**Conditions:** Applies to CIENCE SDRs. Between 60–99% of target: base salary × % of target hit × 0.35. At or above 100% of target: base salary × % of target hit × 0.7.
**Approval Required:** False

**Custom Pricing Available:** True

## Custom Pricing Criteria

- CIENCE scaled credit tiers for higher outbound volumes (discounts as volume grows — specific tiers not publicly listed)
- CIENCE SDR capacity is quoted separately based on level (1, 2, or 3), geography (Offshore, Europe, US), and number of SDRs
- Per-meeting fee for SDR commission calculated from agreed ROI goal using campaign calculator — not a fixed published rate
- Revenue System Setup: Standard vs. Deployed determined by system complexity, not spend level
- CIENCE managed service clients requiring more than 75,000 monthly credits can access scaled credit tiers at volume discounts (specific amounts not publicly listed)

## Enterprise Features

- Revenue System Setup — Deployed Build (bespoke ontology, custom integrations, department-wide scope, embedded FDE for 60 days)
- Custom SDR capacity programs with multiple SDRs at mixed levels and geographies
- Scaled credit tiers at volume discounts for high-outbound-volume organizations
- Two-way CRM sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Outreach, and Salesloft
- Data warehouse integration
- 500+ native connector integrations (CDP)
- MCP server for AI tool integration (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT)
- CLI for command-line operations and scripted workflows
- Configurable AI agent guardrails by action class (Read / Propose / Act)
- Audit trail and append-only activity log for all AI actions
- CRO Agent for forecast and QBR drafting
- Multi-region SDR capacity (Offshore, Europe, US)
- CIENCE Enterprise SDR Solutions: large SDR programs with management layer, reporting rhythm, and coverage model

**Free Trial:** graph8 platform: Free tier with 1,000 contact reveals and 500 execution actions — no credit card required. Team plan: 7-day free trial, no credit card. Tenbound: Free discovery call (30 min) and free self-assessment available before purchase. CIENCE: Free 30-minute discovery call with an account executive.

**Pilot Program:** Not publicly listed. Contact CIENCE for custom program structuring.

**Price Positioning:** graph8 is aggressively positioned as the anti-tax GTM platform: no data tax (search and browse free), no seat tax (unlimited users on the Team plan), and no tool tax (one buyer graph replaces the stack). At $99/month for the full platform with unlimited users, graph8 prices dramatically below the fragmented stack it replaces — which typically includes separate per-seat charges for a data provider ($15–$50/seat/mo), a sequencer ($75–$150/seat/mo), a CRM ($25–$150/seat/mo), and a dialer ($50–$100/seat/mo). The CIENCE managed services layer ($5,000 setup + $2,000/mo + $499/mo platform = $7,499 all-in first month) competes in the outsourced SDR/managed GTM market with transparent, itemized pricing. Tenbound's $1,000 Programmable Revenue Blueprint is explicitly positioned as a low-cost, vendor-neutral diagnostic — cheaper than a consulting engagement ("months, five figures") and more rigorous than a free discovery call.

## Pricing Faqs

### Item 1

**Question:** How big is the graph8 contact dataset?
**Answer:** 700M+ contacts and 100M+ companies. You search and browse the whole thing free on every plan. Reveals, lookups, enrichments, and exports draw credits.

### Item 2

**Question:** How accurate is the graph8 contact data?
**Answer:** Emails and phones are verified before they reach you, so bounce rates stay low. Records that fail verification get flagged, not delivered.

### Item 3

**Question:** Can I bring my own data vendors to graph8?
**Answer:** Yes. The waterfall enriches across multiple providers, and you can plug in your own API keys. You pay on match, or bring your own and blend the sources.

### Item 4

**Question:** Do I own and can I export my graph8 data?
**Answer:** You do. You own everything you pull, and you can export it any time. Exports count as a contact data action, so they draw from the same credit pool.

### Item 5

**Question:** What does the CIENCE first month cost all-in?
**Answer:** $7,499 — this is the GTM setup ($5,000 one-time) plus the strategic team ($2,000/mo) plus the graph8 platform license ($499/mo). SDR capacity is quoted separately.

### Item 6

**Question:** Does buying the Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint commit us to anything further?
**Answer:** No. The blueprint is complete on its own, written for your team to implement, and there is nothing to buy from Tenbound afterwards. You keep all five documents.

### Item 7

**Question:** Does graph8 require system access for the Programmable Revenue Blueprint?
**Answer:** No. The FDE shadows the work on a screen share and reviews what is publicly visible. Access to Search Console, CRM, or other tools makes the blueprint sharper but is not required.

### Item 8

**Question:** Is the Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint refundable?
**Answer:** No. You keep all five documents whether you implement them yourselves, hand them to a vendor, or put them in a drawer. If Tenbound cannot deliver what is described, they say so before week one and refund.

### Item 9

**Question:** What determines Standard vs. Deployed Revenue System Setup?
**Answer:** System complexity — not monthly spend. Custom integrations or a bespoke data model means Deployed ($25,000). Common stacks use the Standard Build ($9,500).

### Item 10

**Question:** Can clients hire CIENCE SDRs directly?
**Answer:** Yes. Clients can hire SDRs directly. SDRs report into your team day to day, with CIENCE systems and Growth Manager supervision.

### Item 11

**Question:** How is the CIENCE per-meeting fee calculated?
**Answer:** The per-meeting fee is calculated from the agreed ROI goal, typically 4x ROI, using the campaign calculator. The exact fee is not a fixed published rate.

### Item 12

**Question:** Is graph8 Work a Slack replacement?
**Answer:** For the room where your revenue team works, yes. Channels, DMs, threads, presence, and notifications work as expected. The difference is that agents are in the room and do the work there. Slack stays connected as an optional integration if the rest of the company lives in it.

## Negotiation Guidelines

- SDR per-meeting fee is negotiable — calculated from the agreed ROI goal (typically 4x ROI) using CIENCE's campaign calculator; bring your pipeline goal and target ACV to the discovery call
- Standard vs. Deployed Revenue System Setup is decided by system complexity, not budget — be transparent about integrations and data model requirements upfront
- Scaled credit pricing for CIENCE platform is available for higher volumes — engage CIENCE account executives with projected monthly send/call/agent volumes
- graph8 Team plan is month-to-month with no contracts — no multi-year discount is publicly listed; ask directly
- CIENCE SDR capacity can be scaled up or down without long-term commitment — use this flexibility to pilot before expanding

# Value Props

## Portfolio scope: graph8, CIENCE, and Tenbound

graph8 helps teams connect buyer data and revenue workflows; CIENCE supplies managed GTM execution; Tenbound helps teams understand their pipeline architecture before choosing changes. Tenbound's specific value is decision clarity: assess the existing system against the Pipeline Architecture Standard and Sales Pipeline Maturity Model, identify gaps, and obtain the scoped Blueprint deliverables. Keep this assessment value distinct from software automation benefits or outsourced execution capacity.

---

# Value Props

## Master Value Prop

**Proposition:** graph8 is the autonomous revenue system that replaces the data tax, seat tax, and tool tax with one buyer graph — connecting 700M+ verified contacts, 2 billion daily buying signals, omnichannel campaign execution, AI agents, native CRM with quote-to-cash, and team collaboration in a single system priced by execution, not seats. Complemented by CIENCE managed GTM execution and Tenbound's engineering-led pipeline assessment, the full portfolio serves B2B teams from first signal to closed revenue — and from diagnosis to full autonomy — without switching tools, re-keying data, or paying per-seat licenses.
**Headline:** One buyer graph. Signal to revenue.
**Target Segment:** B2B revenue teams — SDRs, AEs, RevOps leaders, and CROs — at companies from SMB to enterprise who are drowning in tool sprawl, paying per-seat taxes across five or more disconnected GTM platforms, and still missing pipeline targets because no single system connects buyer signals to closed deals
**Primary Benefit:** Replace eight disconnected GTM tools with one autonomous revenue system on one buyer graph — so every buying signal resolves to a real person, every launch runs automatically, and every rep works the right deal fully briefed — for the entire team at $99/month
**Supporting Benefits:**
- 700M+ verified B2B contacts and 100M+ companies searchable free on every plan — no data tax to see the market
- 2 billion buying signals processed daily across 8 signal types (visitors, intent, forms, hiring, job changes, social, tech stack, funding), all resolved to real people and auto-launched as campaigns
- Full 5-channel sequencer (email, phone, LinkedIn, SMS, WhatsApp) plus AI voice cloning, AI inbox, native CRM, quotes, e-sign, and billing in one $99/month plan — unlimited users, no seat fees
- AI agents (Chief of Staff, SDR Agent, RevOps Agent) operating in configurable Read/Propose/Act modes with full audit trails — automation with human control at the right moment
- CIENCE managed GTM execution: GTM Setup Sprint ($5,000 one-time), Performance-Driven Growth ($2,000/mo), and SDR Capacity (from $1,500/mo) for teams that need execution, not just software
- Tenbound Programmable Revenue Blueprint ($1,000, 3 weeks, 5 deliverable documents) — the engineering-led assessment that maps exactly which pipeline pillar is capping the number before any AI spend
- Studio generates 44 living GTM intelligence documents from a company URL in one session — brand, ICP, messaging, competitive teardown, email sequences, landing pages, battlecards, and more
- MCP Server, CLI, and 500+ native integrations plus two-way CRM sync — the buyer graph works from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, scripts, or any existing stack

**Proof Points:**
- 10 years of real CIENCE outbound data across 2,500+ B2B brands trains the AI — not a generic model
- Millions of real conversations, calls, and campaign outcomes shape scoring and launch playbooks
- CIENCE rated 4.4 average across 8 major review platforms (UpCity 4.8, Clutch 4.4, CrowdReviews 4.8, GoodFirms 4.8)
- CIENCE has served 2,500+ clients across 250+ industry verticals with 115+ documented case studies
- Tenbound's Pipeline Architecture Standard and Maturity Model are published, free, and cited by teams at Okta, LinkedIn, GitLab, Gong, Outreach, and Salesloft
- $10M seed funding; founded 2024; headquartered in Miami, FL

**Differentiator:** The only platform that unifies B2B data intelligence, signal detection, omnichannel sequencing, AI voice and inbox automation, native CRM, quote-to-cash, team collaboration with embedded AI agents, and GTM content generation on a single buyer graph — backed by CIENCE's decade of real campaign data across 2,500+ B2B brands and Tenbound's published Pipeline Architecture Standard for diagnosing before building

## Value Pillars

### Item 1

**Pillar:** One Buyer Graph — No Data Tax, No Tool Sprawl
**Description:** Every signal, contact, conversation, and deal lives on a single buyer graph that every app, agent, and operator reads from and writes to. No sync lag, no nightly jobs, no copy of the truth drifting in a second system. The data layer is free to search — you pay only when the system executes.
**Claims:**
- 700M+ verified B2B contacts and 100M+ companies searchable free on every plan with no per-seat data fee
- One record per buyer — signals, conversations, enrichments, and deal activity all write to the same record, so the CRM, forecast, and rep's desk are never out of date
- Waterfall enrichment across multiple providers with pay-on-match pricing and the ability to bring your own API keys
- Dynamic lists that auto-refresh from a live ICP query — no stale exports, no manual list maintenance
- Visitor identification resolves anonymous site traffic to the company and the real person, with pages viewed and hot flags surfaced automatically
- Built-in CDP with 500+ connectors, two-way CRM sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Outreach, and Salesloft
- MCP Server lets teams query the buyer graph from Claude, Cursor, and ChatGPT; CLI enables scripted workflows from the terminal

**Evidence:**
- 700M+ contacts, 100M+ companies — free to search, revealed on credit
- 2 billion buying signals processed daily across 8 signal types
- 10 years of CIENCE real outbound data shapes every record's scoring and enrichment
- Dedup and merge built in — one record per buyer, not duplicates across tools

**Icon:** graph-node

### Item 2

**Pillar:** Signal to Revenue — Autonomous Execution From First Intent to Closed Deal
**Description:** graph8 doesn't stop at surfacing signals — it turns them into launches automatically. Eight signal types (visitors, intent search, forms, hiring, job changes, social, tech stack, funding) resolve to real people, score for ICP fit, and seed a running campaign on the same buyer graph without a human opening a spreadsheet.
**Claims:**
- Every signal type resolved to the company AND the real person — not just an account name with no one behind it
- Signals auto-scored for intent (0–100) and ICP fit, then surfaced in My Desk ranked by urgency and deal value
- 5-channel sequencer (email, phone, LinkedIn, SMS, WhatsApp) executes the outreach with mailbox management, domain deliverability, and campaign orchestration included
- AI voice agents clone any rep's voice for inbound and outbound calls with live booking and human takeover at the right moment
- AI Inbox triages, drafts, and answers replies across every channel — so no interested reply goes cold
- Meeting routing books the right rep automatically from the right signal
- The entire loop — signal → launch → converse → pipeline → quote → e-sign → billing — runs on one buyer graph without leaving the system

**Evidence:**
- 2 billion buying signals captured daily across all 8 signal types
- My Desk surfaces ranked action cards: meeting prep, at-risk deals, interested replies, intent spikes — one queue, one workspace
- Quote-to-cash flow: branded quote → e-sign → Stripe billing provisioned automatically on signature, replacing PandaDoc, DocuSign, and manual Stripe re-keying
- Weighted pipeline forecast flags at-risk deals 90 days out with variance attribution — no spreadsheet pull required

**Icon:** signal-arrow

### Item 3

**Pillar:** AI Agents With Human Control — Automation That Earns Trust
**Description:** graph8's AI agents (Chief of Staff, SDR Agent, RevOps Agent) run the volume work — research, drafting, enrichment, CRM updates, routing — while humans take the live conversation, the approval, and the close. Every AI action is logged, auditable, and reversible. Agents operate in Read, Propose, or Act mode with org-defined guardrails.
**Claims:**
- Chief of Staff coordinates all specialist agents and posts a daily brief — humans delegate by DM, not by opening another tool
- SDR Agent handles outbound research and draft creation in the rep's own voice, trained on sent mail, calls, and calendar
- RevOps Agent manages CRM updates, deal operations, and pipeline reviews without waiting for a rep to log activity
- Every agent action is shown step-by-step with what was read, called, and changed — a full audit trail, not a chat log
- High-risk and irreversible actions always require human approval — sending, spending, and deleting default to asking
- Routine work runs on a schedule (daily brief, reply digest, stalled deal review) server-side — nobody has to be online
- graph8 Work (team chat) puts people and agents in the same room — channels, DMs, threads, with agents in the directory alongside humans

**Evidence:**
- Three agent modes: Read (observe only), Propose (prepare and wait for approval), Act (run reversible work and report) — configurable per action class
- Activity feed filters by people or agents so managers see exactly what automated vs. human
- CIENCE's model: five AI agents running beside one human SDR — research, deliverability, outbound motion, lead ops, and scheduling handled by AI; live conversation handled by person
- Team HQ leaderboard tracks both human rep and AI agent activity in the same live feed

**Icon:** agent-shield

### Item 4

**Pillar:** GTM Strategy and Content in One Session — Studio Replaces the Agency
**Description:** Studio learns a company's business from its website URL, researches its market and competitors, and generates 44 living strategy documents plus every campaign deliverable — brand kit, email sequences, landing pages, ad copy, call scripts, battlecards, and SEO/AEO-optimized content — in one session. What an agency builds in weeks, Studio builds in minutes.
**Claims:**
- 44 AI-generated intelligence documents across four living pillars: Brand, ICP, Offer, and Proof — the source context for every campaign, agent, and page
- Campaign Engine scores ideas by fit, speed, and expected impact and ranks them so teams launch the strongest play first
- Full deliverables generated per campaign: email sequence, LinkedIn copy, call script, landing page, ad set, and battlecard
- Brand and design system derived from the company site — logo lockups, color tokens, type scale, and voice applied to every asset
- Landing page visual editor: edit any block by chatting with Studio, with version control, custom domains, and one-click publish
- SEO-optimized pages and AEO-tuned answers tracked for both rank and AI engine citation
- Per-account intelligence refreshed automatically on new signal — fit analysis, pain map, value props, deal signals, so every rep walks in briefed

**Evidence:**
- 44 living strategy documents generated from one URL — versioned, auditable, always current
- Studio Agent has full context across all 44 documents and can be @mentioned in any channel for source-cited answers
- AEO optimization targets AI answer engine citation alongside traditional search ranking
- Account intelligence refreshes automatically when a new signal lands on the buyer graph

**Icon:** studio-spark

### Item 5

**Pillar:** CIENCE Managed Execution — The GTM Engine, Not Another Isolated Tool
**Description:** CIENCE delivers the human execution layer that runs on top of graph8's autonomous system — a forward-deployed team that builds the GTM motion in a 5-day sprint, then manages it month-to-month with dedicated strategic oversight. SDR capacity is sourced, trained, and managed at three performance levels across offshore, European, and US tiers — scalable up or down without long-term contracts.
**Claims:**
- GTM Setup Sprint ($5,000 one-time): complete system and 4 campaigns (intent-based, ICP-driven, visitor targeting, competitor targeting) live in 5 days
- Performance-Driven Growth ($2,000/mo): dedicated GTM team with full-scale campaign management and continuous optimization
- graph8 platform license included at $499/mo with 75,000 monthly credits for AI-driven outreach and visitor deanonymization
- SDR Capacity: sourced, trained, and managed SDR teams at Level 1 (Scripted Outreach), Level 2 (Independent Producer), Level 3 (Data-Driven Optimizer) — priced from $1,500/mo offshore to $6,500/mo US
- Scaled Outbound: managed cold email, targeted campaigns, and high-volume outbound with built-in compliance, cost, and quality controls
- Inbound Optimization: managed inbound SDR service that qualifies MQLs and converts them to SQLs with booked appointments
- Audience Data: data operations identifying and reaching best-fit buyers across every channel

**Evidence:**
- 4.4 average rating across 8 major review platforms: UpCity 4.8, Clutch 4.4, CrowdReviews 4.8, GoodFirms 4.8, G2 4.0, TrustRadius 4.3, Google 4.0, Gartner Peer Insights 4.1

- 115+ documented public case studies
- CIENCE campaign performance data across a decade trains graph8's AI models — real outcomes, not synthetic data
- Client list includes Okta, Microsoft, Google, Uber, Salesforce, Segment, Airbnb, BetterHelp, and 2,500+ B2B teams

**Icon:** team-execution

### Item 6

**Pillar:** Tenbound Pipeline Assessment — Know Before You Build
**Description:** Tenbound's Programmable Revenue Blueprint is a $1,000 three-week engineering-led assessment that maps exactly how a revenue team makes pipeline — by watching real work, not reading process documents. Five deliverable documents (revenue ontology, integration gaps, maturity readout, setup document, improvement proposal) give revenue leaders the plan to fix the right pillar before spending on AI or headcount.
**Claims:**
- Programmable Revenue Blueprint ($1,000 one-time): forward-deployed engineer shadows up to 7 roles, 45 minutes each, in week one — no system access required, no homework for reps
- Five deliverable documents: revenue ontology, integration gaps document, maturity readout (six pillars, four levels), setup document, and improvement proposal — all yours to implement with any vendor
- Pipeline Architecture Standard: six-pillar framework (Market, Signal, Message, Motion, Mastery, Measurement) published free for any team to read, score, and build on

- No vendor on the other side of the plan — the documents are implementable in-house or with any vendor the client chooses

**Evidence:**

## Outcome Statements
